text.p: SBC Communications Inc is seen requesting permission to enter the long-distance telephone market Friday, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The newspaper said the company was expected to file a 5,000-page application with the U.S. Federal Communications Commission claiming it qualified to enter the long-distance business in Oklahoma, where it faced local competition.

SBC general counsel Jim Ellis was quoted as saying in the Journal: "We're as happy as we can be; it took a long-time coming." Ellis was quoted as saying the company hoped to win FCC approval within 90 days.
